baseline: complete eligible documents for compact; independent FTS5/BM25 20-line windows stride15 for large
context_admission: UTF-8 message bytes plus1536 output allowance plus2048 template reserve <=32768. Conservative admission check, not native tokenizer measurement. No truncation.
large_scope_fit: 457462 bytes and about67K words exceeds conservative configured32K admission profile. Exact full-corpus native token count is unmeasured; no claim it cannot fit the advertised262144 model maximum.
presentation: Same JSON source packets in both arms; preserve immutable source hashes, exact source spans, lifecycle, freshness, authority and origin. KRE native packing remains unchanged and may allocate less text than baseline under its richer internal serialization.
quality: Strict JSON/schema, exact spans/quotes, evidencecoverage plus independent blinded human review; unknown semantics never passed.
continuation: Frozen user checkpoint, deterministic lifecycle update and resume before a single generation per arm; not generated multi-turn workflow performance.
stopping: Stop dispatch on operator STOP/SIGINT, deadline, identity/config/telemetry drift, resource pressure, competing residency or technical failure; retain every attempt. Finish current request on soft stop then unload. Unknown completion halts without unsafe force-unload or retry.
quiet_window: Operator-confirmed dedicated quiet window in existinginstallation; no agent/scheduler modifications. Empty /api/ps alone is not a workload reservation.
